local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local function getRoot()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function getHum()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    return character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

    local remotePath = {"ReplicatedStorage", "dataRemoteEvent"}
    local remote = game
    for _, childName in ipairs(remotePath) do
        remote = remote and remote:FindFirstChild(childName)
    end
    if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        local args = table.pack({[1] = {}, [2] = "I"})
        local unpackArgs = table.unpack or unpack
        remote:FireServer(unpackArgs(args, 1, args.n))
    end
end
do local h = getHum(); if h then h:MoveTo(Vector3.new(-96.8, 3.3, -56.3)) end end
task.wait(0.11)

task.wait(0.05)
do
    local remotePath = {"ReplicatedStorage", "dataRemoteEvent"}
    local remote = game
    for _, childName in ipairs(remotePath) do
        remote = remote and remote:FindFirstChild(childName)
    end
    if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        local args = table.pack({[1] = {}, [2] = "I", [3] = {}, [4] = "I", [5] = {}, [6] = "I", [7] = {}, [8] = "I"})
        local unpackArgs = table.unpack or unpack
        remote:FireServer(unpackArgs(args, 1, args.n))
    end
end
do local h = getHum(); if h then h:MoveTo(Vector3.new(-96.8, 3.3, -56.3)) end end
task.wait(45.22)
do
    local remotePath = {"ReplicatedStorage", "dataRemoteEvent"}
    local remote = game
    for _, childName in ipairs(remotePath) do
        remote = remote and remote:FindFirstChild(childName)
    end
    if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        local args = table.pack({[1] = {}, [2] = "M"})
        local unpackArgs = table.unpack or unpack
        remote:FireServer(unpackArgs(args, 1, args.n))
    end
end

-- Cleanup
do local h = getHum(); if h then h.Jump = false; h:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end end
